verdict.rationale: Manufact documents an official CLI that covers the full workflow: run/build servers locally with hot reload (manufact-docs-15), deploy to Manufact Cloud (manufact-docs-16, manufact-docs-26), manage servers/deployments/env vars from the terminal, and authenticate via API keys for CI/scripts (manufact-docs-17). Installation into agents/clients is supported via one-click installs/copy-paste config (manufact-docs-18, manufact-docs-27) and an MCP server exposing platform management to clients like Cursor/Claude (manufact-docs-14, manufact-docs-31). Missing for 10: explicit CLI-driven 'install into agent' subcommand (install appears dashboard-driven rather than CLI-driven) and independent/hands-on confirmation of the full CLI workflow beyond first-party docs.
